DoorDash CLI installer
======================

This folder contains:

  dd-cli-v0.2.0-darwin-arm64   The DoorDash CLI binary (macOS Apple Silicon)
  install.sh                   Install script
  quickstart.txt               This file
  skills/                      Agent skills (can be installed with install.sh)
  LICENSE.txt                  DoorDash CLI Access Terms of Service
  THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt      Open-source license attributions

How to install
--------------

1. Open Terminal (Cmd + Space, type "Terminal", hit Enter).

2. Type "cd " (with a space after it), then drag this folder from
   Finder into the Terminal window. It will paste the full path.
   Press Enter.

3. Run the install script:

     bash install.sh

   This will:
   - Copy the binary to ~/.local/bin/dd-cli
   - Make it executable
   - Remove the macOS quarantine warning

4. Make sure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH. If "dd-cli --help" doesn't work
   after installing, run this once and restart Terminal:

     echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc

5. Sign in to DoorDash:

     dd-cli login

Done! Try "dd-cli --help" to see all available commands.

Using with AI agents
--------------------

DoorDash CLI works best with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or other
terminal-based AI agents. The installer places an agent skill file so
your agent automatically knows about DoorDash CLI — no priming needed. Just
start a session and ask for what you want.

If you skipped skill install or use a different agent, copy the skill
from this folder:

  skills/dd-cli-usage/SKILL.md

to your agent's skill directory. Common locations:

  Claude Code:  ~/.claude/skills/dd-cli-usage/
  Cursor:       ~/.cursor/skills/dd-cli-usage/
  Codex:        ~/.agents/skills/dd-cli-usage/
  OpenClaw:     ~/.openclaw/skills/dd-cli-usage/

Example usage:

  > Find sushi near me

  Agent runs:
    dd-cli search --query "sushi near me"

  > Reorder my last meal but skip the drink

  Agent runs:
    dd-cli order history
    dd-cli order reorder --order-uuid abc123-def456
    dd-cli cart show --cart-uuid 789xyz
    dd-cli cart remove-item --cart-uuid 789xyz --cart-item-id 42
    dd-cli order checkout-url --cart-uuid 789xyz
